feature.cookie.analytics: The QR feature does not use analytics cookies. No profiling or third-party analytics tools are integrated into this feature.
feature.cookie.external: External maps, videos, fonts, widgets or third-party services may have their own rules. Each integration must be assessed separately and described on this page.
feature.cookie.hero.subtitle: Information about technical cookies and measurement tools.
feature.cookie.lead: Lauco Experience uses technical tools required for operation and security. The new territorial QR measurement runs server-side with aggregate counters and does not install analytics cookies.
feature.cookie.qr.body: A scan first reaches an internal endpoint that only increments that QR code’s daily total and then redirects to the authorised destination. No profile, analytics session or individual scan history is created.
feature.cookie.qr.detail: The territorial QR redirect increments an aggregate counter by day and QR code. This feature sets no cookies, uses no client-side identifiers and stores no IP address, user agent, location or visitor identifier in the statistics database.
feature.cookie.qr.title: QR statistics without tracking cookies
feature.cookie.technical: They may be used for proper site operation, session and language management, security and form submission.
feature.cookie.update.body: If analytics tools, external maps, embedded videos or marketing services are added in the future, this page must be updated and any consent requirements reassessed.
feature.cookie.update.note: Last updated: August 2026. Cookie classification must be reviewed whenever scripts, plugins or external services are added to the site.
feature.forra.access.body1: Vinaio is the local reference point for access to the gorge. Before setting out, check the latest directions on the dedicated website and the signage on site.
feature.forra.access.body2: A stop in the Vinaio area can also be combined with nearby routes and points of interest.
feature.forra.access.title: Access and Vinaio
feature.forra.conditions.equipment: equipment and preparation appropriate to the chosen route.
feature.forra.conditions.signage: condition of access points and signage;
feature.forra.conditions.title: Conditions to check
feature.forra.hero.subtitle: Nature, access and information to prepare your visit.
feature.forra.info.body: For the route, map, safety, environment, geology, flora and fauna, consult the dedicated Vinadia Gorge website. Conditions on the ground can change: always refer to the most recent information available.
feature.forra.info.title: Up-to-date information
feature.forra.intro.body: Vinadia Gorge is one of the territory’s most distinctive natural attractions. This page integrates it into Lauco Experience without replacing the dedicated website: it gathers essential orientation information and connects the visit with Vinaio, the trails and other points of interest.
feature.forra.intro.subtitle: A local access point connecting the gorge with the Lauco area.
feature.forra.intro.title: Vinadia Gorge in Lauco Experience
feature.forra.note: Lauco Experience is an orientation tool and does not replace assessment of actual conditions, personal preparation, or instructions from authorities and organisations responsible for the area.
feature.forra.safety.body: Entering the gorge requires experience and suitable equipment. Before visiting, check the weather, water conditions and current information; a guide is recommended for the inner gorge.
feature.forra.safety.title: Safety comes first.
feature.forra.territory.body: The visit can be combined with Vinaio, the trail network, panoramic points and the rest area above the bridge, placing the gorge within a broader experience of the Lauco plateau.
feature.forra.territory.title: Gorge and territory
feature.forra.title: Vinadia Gorge
feature.privacy.form.provision: Providing data through a form is optional, but is necessary to receive a response or allow a report to be handled.
feature.privacy.lead: This notice briefly describes how data collected through Lauco Experience is processed, including site forms and aggregate measurement of territorial QR codes.
feature.privacy.qr.body: The QR redirect directly increments a daily counter associated with the code. No row is created for each visit and the component neither reads nor sets analytics cookies. Any general technical web infrastructure logs remain separate from this statistics feature.
feature.privacy.qr.data: For territorial QR codes, the statistics database stores only the date, QR code and aggregate number of scans for that day. The statistics system does not store IP addresses, user agents, geolocation, device identifiers or visitor identifiers.
feature.privacy.qr.purpose: To measure in aggregate which information points are consulted and improve signage, content and service. The counters are not designed to reconstruct an individual visitor’s route or perform profiling.
feature.privacy.qr.title: Privacy-by-design QR measurement
feature.privacy.retention: Form data is retained for the time needed to handle the request and in accordance with rules applicable to administrative records. QR statistics remain aggregated by day and code.
